articles.title: Mumbai: BMC Invites Public Objections To Mulund East Petrol Pump Proposal On Land Reserved For Sports Complex
articles.description: The BMC has invited public objections and suggestions to replace a 4,247.50-sq-metre sports complex and stadium reservation in Mulund East with a petrol pump. Critics have questioned the land allocation and the pump’s proximity to a school. The proposal has faced political opposition, while activist Sagar Devre is preparing a PIL seeking restoration of the reservation.
